title: Car-Free Day
description: Avoid using your personal car for one full day and choose walking, cycling or public transport.

title: Walk 5,000 Steps
description: Replace a short vehicle journey with walking and complete at least 5,000 steps.

title: Public Transport Week
description: Use buses or trains instead of a personal vehicle for your daily commute for one week.

title: Switch Off Lights
description: Turn off unnecessary lights and electrical appliances whenever you leave a room.

title: Reduce AC Usage
description: Increase your AC temperature slightly and reduce unnecessary cooling for one week.

title: Meat-Free Day
description: Choose a plant-based diet for one complete day.

title: Reduce Food Waste
description: Plan your meals carefully and avoid throwing away edible food.

title: Reusable Bottle
description: Use a reusable water bottle instead of buying single-use plastic bottles.

title: Recycle for a Week
description: Separate recyclable materials from general household waste for seven days.

title: Eco Champion
description: Complete at least five sustainability challenges in one month.
